[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Interleaving string** [LC 97 · Interleaving String](https://leetcode.com/problems/interleaving-string/){difficulty="Medium"}

The index in `s3` is `i + j` once `i` letters have been taken from `s1` and `j` from `s2`. The last letter of that prefix came from one of the two strings, and only if that string's next letter equals it. Preferring `s1` whenever both match gets stuck on the first sample: the `b` at position 3 has to come from `s2`. Both choices have to stay alive.

[Solved in full in @sec-st-p3-inter.]{.card-link}
